basic_details.job_title: Manipur Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Block Technology Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Agriculture, Government of Manipur invites online applications for Block Technology Manager (BTM) and Assistant Technology Manager (ATM) on contract basis under the "Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension" - 2026. Registration will start from 6 November 2026 and the last date of registration is 26 November 2026. The application fee is Rs. 800/- for General/OBC and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST; differently abled candidates are fee exempted. Candidates register on the department's recruitment portal using their own mobile number.

how_to_apply: Login on the recruitment portal using your own personal mobile number. Do not use another person's number, as the same number is needed to login later.
Upload the self-attested scanned documents, your passport size photo and the photo of your signature.
Pay the fee online by Internet Banking, Credit/Debit Card, UPI etc.
Finish the registration. To continue an incomplete registration or view a completed one, login again with the same phone number and date of birth, or with an OTP.
Post Graduation certificate and marksheet (for BTM - Agriculture/Allied Sector with computer skill)
Reservation or Social Category certificate, OBC/SC/ST (if applicable)
One recent passport size photo and a photo of the signature
important_instructions: Documents and images must be in JPG/JPEG format and each file must not exceed 500KB. Recommended photo size is width 350px and height 400px; for the signature, width 500px and height 200px. For Graduation and Post-Graduation, attach the final/consolidated marksheet. Documents to be uploaded are self-attested. For strictly technical queries, send your name, registered mobile number and application number (if applicable) to [email protected]. The notice says all technical issues are resolved only through this email. For queries on the recruitment process, contact the Department of Agriculture on 98625 40488. The support call timing printed is 10:30am to 4pm (Mon-Fri).

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: The posts of Block Technology Manager and Assistant Technology Manager are advertised by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Manipur. They are to be filled on contract basis under the Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension - 2026. The notice is published on the department's recruitment portal, which also runs the registration and fee payment.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a separate eligibility paragraph. The qualifications below are taken from the list of documents candidates must upload during registration. A Ph.D. degree certificate is to be uploaded "if applicable". The notice prints no experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.details: Registration starts 6 November 2026; last date 26 November 2026
Recruitment of BTM and ATM under Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension - 2026

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Manipur Agriculture Department BTM and ATM recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of registration is 26 November 2026. Registration will start from 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are advertised?
faq.answer: Block Technology Manager (BTM) and Assistant Technology Manager (ATM) are advertised on contract basis under the "Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension" - 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BTM and ATM?
faq.answer: The document list names Class X, Class XII and Graduation (Agriculture/Allied Sector) for both posts. For BTM it also names Post Graduation (Agriculture/Allied Sector with computer skill).

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 800/- for General/OBC and Rs. 500/- for SC/ST. Differently abled candidates are fee exempted. The fee is paid online.

faq.question: Q5. How can I pay the fee?
faq.answer: The fee is paid online through Internet Banking, Credit/Debit Card, UPI etc. as part of the registration steps.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Login on the recruitment portal with your own mobile number, fill up Personal Details and Academic Details, upload the documents, photo and signature, and pay the fee online.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must be uploaded?
faq.answer: Class X, Class XII, Graduation and (for BTM) Post Graduation certificates and marksheets are listed. Ph.D., reservation, PwD and No Objection certificates are to be uploaded if applicable, with a passport size photo and signature.

faq.question: Q8. What file format and size are allowed?
faq.answer: Each document or image must be in JPG/JPEG format and not exceed 500KB.

faq.question: Q9. Can I continue an incomplete registration later?
faq.answer: Yes. Login again with the same phone number and date of birth, or with OTP, to continue an incomplete registration or view a completed one.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: The notice advertises the posts on contract basis. It does not print the length of the contract.
